sources.finding: With menu nil and changesSelectionAsPrimaryAction true, UIKit toggles the native selected state.
Public on/off/mixed toggle accessibility trait; adding the button trait yields VoiceOver switch-button description.
Native button handles incoming touch events and focused activation through target-action; appearance is configurable.
Default cancellation is false for UIControl; the prototype explicitly permits native scroll arbitration for its toggle.
When cancellation is enabled, sufficient drag cancels the content view's touch and scrolls.
